headline: Fixes from your first G500 ride

items.title: Rides no longer go missing
items.line: A quick Start and restart can't hide the ride anymore. Today's: Rides → Restore discarded ride.

items.title: Each scooter learns on its own
items.line: Battery estimates and "more than usual" no longer use your old scooter's rides.

items.title: Music comes back
items.line: After a spoken line, your music returns to full volume.

full: The speed colours on the ride map now go up to your ride's top speed, not just 50 km/h.
G500: battery % now counts down while you ride, from the power used, instead of waiting for a stop.
Battery % no longer flickers by 1 while the scooter stands.

headline: G500 battery and range

items.title: Battery % for the G500
items.line: Read from the battery's voltage when the scooter stands still.

items.title: Range starts learning
items.line: Its 21 Ah battery is known, so km left and battery health can learn.

items.title: Steadier temperature
items.line: No more short dips at high speed.

full: G500: battery % estimated from the resting voltage (16-cell Li-ion curve), updated after 10 s standing still; battery size from its model (21 Ah), changeable in Settings.
G500: temperature shows the highest reading of the last 10 seconds.

headline: Rides on phone GPS when needed

items.title: GPS rides saved right
items.line: If the app can't read a scooter, the ride still gets its time, map and km from GPS.

items.title: G500 numbers
items.line: Speed, power and rides from your G500, as in the last update.

items.title: Same safe connection
items.line: The app only reads from the scooter, never sends it anything.

full: A ride with a scooter connected whose data the app can't read was saved with 0 s and no map; it now switches to phone GPS after a few seconds, like a dropped connection.

headline: Your G500's numbers

items.title: Speed and rides
items.line: The G500's speed is read, so rides get their km, time and top speed.

items.title: Power and energy
items.line: Volts, amps and Wh per ride, like on the G100.

items.title: What it doesn't send
items.line: The G500 sends no total km or battery %: those stay empty, never guessed.

full: RND G500 decoded from your first ride: speed (wheel turns, checked against GPS), voltage, current, temperature, brake and motor. Ride distance comes from the wheel speed.

headline: Setup finds your scooter

items.title: Found right away
items.line: Setup shows your scooter the moment it connects.

items.title: Then tap Connect
items.line: Connect saves it, also a G500.

items.title: Numbers come next
items.line: The G500 shows no battery or km until its data is decoded.

full: Setup could keep searching while the scooter was already connected; it now follows the connection itself.

headline: Your G500 can be saved

items.title: Connect saves it
items.line: In setup, Connect now saves your scooter every time.

items.title: No wrong numbers
items.line: The G500 shows "numbers not supported yet" until its data is decoded.

items.title: Still looking
items.line: After Set up later the app keeps looking for your scooter.

full: Setup: Connect saves the scooter also when iOS reconnected it on its own.
A scooter you never saved is no longer reconnected in the background.
A scooter whose data the app can't read yet shows no battery or km; its raw data is still kept, so it can be decoded next.

hero: Bug #100 fixed 🎉 Thanks for every report.
headline: Room for more than one scooter

items.title: Garage
items.line: Add a second scooter. The app follows the one you switch on.

items.title: Tyre pressure hint
items.line: If battery use creeps up on your usual routes, the Tyres tile tells you.

items.title: Stats per scooter
items.line: All scooters together, or one at a time.

full: Bug #100 fixed: thanks for every report (a one-time thank-you).

Garage: a new scooter is added by itself when it connects, named after its model; the one switched on is the one in use; each keeps its own battery, charge log, maintenance and service book; places, routes, prices and settings are shared.
Garage: Sold, Lost or Remove keeps its rides and its service book; Just borrowing gives no maintenance alerts.
Stats: all scooters by default, with a scooter menu once you have two.

Tyre pressure hint: compares battery use only with your rides on the same route in similar weather, speed and load; a slow rise points at the tyres, a sudden one at the brakes or wheel; every tap is optional.
The lock screen shows the scooter's name once you have two.

headline: Your new scooter is found

items.title: RND G500 works
items.line: The app now finds the G500 as well as the G100.

items.title: Named after its model
items.line: A G500 shows up as RND G500 when you connect it.

items.title: Same safe connection
items.line: The app only reads from the scooter, never sends it anything.

items.title: Cleaner logo
items.line: The thin white ring around the Home logo is gone.

full: The app looked only for the name G2; it now knows a list of names (G2 = RND G100, G500 = RND G500). Same read-only connection.
The scooter keeps its model name on later connections too.
Home logo: the light rim at the edge of the round logo is cut away.

headline: New logo, quicker parts, charging test

items.title: New logo on Home
items.line: The top left of Home shows the round CorckieApp logo.

items.title: One tap to a part
items.line: On the Scooter tab, tapping Brakes, Tyres, Motor and the others opens that part's own page.

items.title: Charging speed, no typing (test)
items.line: Battery, Measure charging speed: switch the scooter on for 15 seconds every 20 minutes while it charges. 3 steady readings are enough.

full: Home's top-left logo is the new round C on black.
A part tile or a Maintenance row opens that part's page directly: what was found or the next check, its reminder, Log what I did. Nothing pops up on top.
Experimental: charging speed from switch-on readings. While it runs, switching on does not end the charge timer, and these readings never count for the battery or charger checks.

headline: Your scooter's health

items.title: Maintenance, all in one place
items.line: Scooter tab: a card with every part. Tap it for the new Maintenance screen, the next checks in km and Log what I did.

items.title: Warns you only when it's sure
items.line: The app learns your scooter for 10 rides, then tells you if something is really wrong: once, clearly, never for a guess.

items.title: A report for your mechanic
items.line: Export a report makes a PDF and a data file in English or Hebrew, so you don't have to explain.

items.title: Service history
items.line: Everything you logged and every finding, with a PDF to keep or show a buyer.

full: Faults the app can recognise: battery strain, power cuts, brakes not cutting the motor, tyre soft or worn, motor running hot, impossible sensor readings, battery draining while parked, charger not filling the battery, km counter reset.
During a ride only two are spoken: a power cut (the 2nd and 4th in a ride) and brakes not cutting the motor (when it repeats), with a red light on the ride screen.
After a ride, at most one warning shows over the ride summary: Tell me more, Export a report, Got it. Checked, it's fine makes the app less sensitive to it.
At switch-on: battery and charger findings, and a km counter reset.
The Battery page shows battery findings on top. A dot on the Scooter tab and a line on Home appear only when something needs doing.
Home logo is the C only; list rows are white again; the ride colour strip is a straight bar.

headline: The welcome picture

items.title: Welcome picture
items.line: The welcome screen now shows the CorckieApp picture: two riders at sunset.

items.title: See it again
items.line: Settings, About, App tour shows the short tour again.

items.title: Nothing else changed
items.line: Everything from the last update stays as it was.

full: The welcome screen shows the CorckieApp picture instead of the plain orange glow.

headline: Easier first steps, and range in km

items.title: Kilometres left
items.line: The live battery tile shows about how many km you have left, and the voice says the same number.

items.title: Cost and km left on every ride
items.line: The ride summary has two new tiles: what the ride cost in electricity, and km left at the end.

items.title: Hide where you start and end
items.line: Sharing a ride (Replay file, GPX, CSV) first asks if you want to hide its start and end.

items.title: A welcome for new riders
items.line: A welcome screen and a short tour on first open. Settings, About, App tour shows it again.

full: The ride replay sound plays to its end.
Live battery tile: about N km left under the %, 'learning range' until your rides give a range.
Voice: 'Battery at 80 percent, about 18 kilometres left.' and 'Using 15 percent more than usual. About 16 kilometres left.' The % per km rate is no longer spoken.
Ride summary: 8 tiles, + Cost and km left.
Sharing or exporting a ride asks: Hide start and end, or Share full route.
New install: a welcome screen and a 7-card tour, then onboarding opens by itself; no What's new card, no location pop-up before setup.
Onboarding: after 30 s without the scooter it says what to try and which scooters work; clearer words for location and alerts; one safety line.
The build number is no longer on every screen (Settings, About keeps it).
Home on day 0 shows only the status and Start; the Load row comes after 3 rides.
Empty Routes and Stats say how they fill; the empty Scooter tab has a Connect button.
The scooter card uses its model name.
'Full at' says 'learning' until your charging speed is learned.
Holidays only for phones set to Israel.
Map and weather credits in Settings, About, Credits.
More text grows with your text size setting.

headline: Fixes for the new iPhone look

items.title: No more grey bands
items.line: The grey strips at the top and bottom of the screen are gone, and the Settings and logo buttons are round again.

items.title: Move centre shows the map
items.line: Moving a place's centre (or drawing its outline) shows the normal map again, not a satellite image.

items.title: The pin follows your finger
items.line: Touch the pin and slide: it moves with your finger and the map stays still.

full: Nothing else changed.

headline: Finishing touches

items.title: More warning lights
items.line: Rain within 20 minutes, dark before you arrive, power limit soon, a gear reminder and a recording problem now light up too. Ones that didn't fit show on the ride summary.

items.title: The ride lands on its summary
items.line: When you end a ride, the time, battery and speed tiles fly into their places on the summary, and the numbers count up as the route draws.

items.title: Touch every chart
items.line: Drag across Insights and the Battery report too. On Stats, today's bar stands out.

full: The charging bolt turns into a green battery at your charge target.
Settings → Data & backup → Backup shows a green tick when a backup is done.
The Scooter tab's battery icon shows the real level, and the scooter icon turns green when it connects.
Your savings icon on Stats hops when you pass ₪100, ₪250, ₪500 and so on.

headline: Calmer warnings while you ride

items.title: Warning lights
items.line: Small icons at the top of the ride screen, like a car's dashboard: red, amber or blue, and nothing when all is fine. At a stop, tap one to read it.

items.title: Battery turns amber, then red
items.line: The battery number and its edge turn amber at 20 % and red at 10 %.

items.title: Turn back in two steps
items.line: On a tight trip you hear "Turn-back point in one kilometre", then "Turn back now to make it back" at the point.

full: Less urgent warnings play one soft tone instead of speaking.
Fast speeds are always kept: a reading above 50 km/h, or a sudden jump, is no longer thrown away.

headline: The app comes alive

items.title: Your scooter on the Lock Screen
items.line: When the scooter connects, a card shows km left with a Start ride button. While riding it quietly shows Recording, and at your destination End ride or Keep going.

items.title: Your ride draws itself
items.line: After a ride, and the first time you open one, the route draws in its speed colours with a sound and a buzz you can feel that follows your speed.

items.title: Start from Control Center
items.line: Add Free ride or Ride to next to Control Center or the Action button, or ask Siri: "Ride to Work in CorckieApp".

items.title: Touch the charts
items.line: Drag across Stats bars or the Battery log to read each day or moment.

full: On iOS 26 the tab bar, map buttons and live tiles are Liquid Glass. Sunlight mode keeps solid panels.
Cards grow into their screens and shrink back when you swipe down (iOS 18).
Icons react: Start squishes, the bag hops when you pick a load, the charging bolt pulses, the gear turns.
While charging, the Battery card glows softly; it turns green-gold when full.
New sounds for connecting, starting, ending, plugging in, a full charge and saving. Settings → Sounds → Charging and saving turns the new ones off.
One clear rule for vibration, and Settings → Sounds → Vibration turns it all off.
Ride, route and place lists shrink a little at the edges as you scroll.

headline: Calmer screens, safer backups

items.title: A clearer Battery log
items.line: One smooth battery line with your average, Day and Week views, and a single line on top: % now, charges and rides. Tap a day to open it.

items.title: Backups off the phone
items.line: Settings → Data & backup → Backup: choose a folder in iCloud Drive and every ride is backed up there. If the folder is gone, backups stay on the phone until you choose it again.

items.title: Remove a place
items.line: Open a place and tap Remove place. It leaves Where to, Home and the maps; past rides keep its name. Places → Removed places puts it back.

full: The ⓘ explanations open right under their heading instead of a sheet; tap again to close.
The tab you're on shows its name.
Lists fade softly above the tab bar, and a light blur sits behind the tab bar and the map buttons.
Restoring rider info from an older backup works after this update too.

headline: More control, fewer surprises

items.title: Every alert has its own switch
items.line: Settings → Notifications lists them in groups: rides, charging and tips. Switch-on, charge and battery wear alerts can now be turned off one by one.

items.title: Your own charging speed
items.line: Battery → Measure charging speed: type the scooter's % every 20 minutes while it charges, and the charge-time estimates use your speed.

items.title: Bring your rides back
items.line: After Start fresh without keeping your info, Bring rider info back returns your places, routes and old rides. Setup also has a Restore link for a new phone.

full: Prices are one screen: fuel price, electricity and fuel use, and price history.
Settings → Battery is now called Battery setup, so it no longer shares a name with the Battery page.
The battery size is learned from your rides (for example 16 Ah, learned from 5 rides) and the pack voltage class is noted.
Home says when iPhone notifications are off, and a ride says when Motion is off, each with a way to Settings.
A ride with no GPS says why and how to fix it.
Tyre pressure no longer shows a fixed number; check it against your scooter's manual.

headline: Welcome to CorckieApp

items.title: Ready for a new scooter
items.line: Settings → Data & backup → Start fresh makes a backup, then starts the battery numbers over. Setup now shows which scooter it found (model, km, battery) before you connect.

items.title: Bluetooth, explained
items.line: If Bluetooth is off or not allowed for CorckieApp, Home and setup say so and take you to the right place.

items.title: A cleaner app
items.line: Test buttons and notes are gone from your screens, and the build is ready for other riders.

full: Start fresh (Settings → Data & backup): a backup first, then the scooter's battery numbers and estimates start over. You choose whether your places, routes and ride times stay.
Setup names the scooter it found (for example “RND G100 · 3 km · 87 %”), so you can match the km with its dashboard. The scooter is saved only when you press Connect, and the closest one is chosen.
A clear message when Bluetooth is off or not allowed for CorckieApp, on Home and in setup.
The iPhone's Bluetooth question is explained on the first setup screen.
Thumbs and notes on rides are gone.
A copy of your data is made before an update, and the update-failed screen says how to share the report.
A clearer message when your data comes from a newer version of the app.
